sources.title: phi-3-mini-4k-instruct: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct is a 3.8 billion parameter language model built by microsoft that generates text responses to instructions and questions. The model uses a dense decoder-only Transformer architecture trained on 3.3 trillion tokens combining synthetic data and filtered public websites, with emphasis on high-quality, reasoning-dense properties.
